name: EffGS
definition: EffGS is an acceleration framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that improves training and rendering efficiency while maintaining high-fidelity reconstruction in both bounded and large-scale scenes. It combines frequency-aware guidance, localized density control, and adaptive primitive scale modulation.
